# hetznerrobot_boot_rescue (Resource)

Activates the Rescue System of a dedicated server. It takes effect on the next reboot — pair it with `hetznerrobot_server_reset` — and is used up by that boot: Robot then reports `active = false`, which the resource keeps as a fact rather than activating the system again. Only one boot configuration can be active at a time. Destroying the resource deactivates the Rescue System if it is still pending.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Boot server 321 into the Rescue System: activate it, then reset the server.
# The reset runs again whenever a new activation brings a new password.
resource "hetznerrobot_boot_rescue" "rescue" {
  server_number   = 321
  os              = "linux"
  authorized_keys = [hetznerrobot_ssh_key.admin.fingerprint]
}

resource "hetznerrobot_server_reset" "into_rescue" {
  server_number = hetznerrobot_boot_rescue.rescue.server_number
  type          = "hw"
  triggers = {
    activation = hetznerrobot_boot_rescue.rescue.password
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `os` (String) Rescue System to boot, e.g. `linux` or `vkvm` (see `hetznerrobot_boot.rescue_os`).
- `server_number` (Number) Server to configure.

### Optional

- `authorized_keys` (Set of String) Fingerprints of SSH keys stored in Robot (`hetznerrobot_ssh_key.fingerprint`) to authorize for root instead of relying on the password. Changing them activates the configuration anew; setting them after an import that could not read them does not.
- `keyboard` (String) Keyboard layout, e.g. `de`. Robot defaults to `us`. Robot does not report it back, so setting it after an import does not activate the configuration anew; changing it does.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the configuration is still pending. Robot clears it once the server has booted it.
- `host_keys` (List of String) Host key fingerprints of the booted system, as far as Robot reports them.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Root (or Administrator) password Robot generated on activation. Only the activation answer carries it, so it stays as it was after the configuration is used up.
- `server_ip` (String) Main IP address of the server.
- `server_ipv6_net` (String) Main IPv6 net of the server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Only a pending (still active) activation can be imported.
tofu import hetznerrobot_boot_rescue.rescue 321
```
